dedupe_keys.name: simple design preference assessment instrument for design of resilient sustainable office buildings

description: SIMPLE-Design: Preference assessment instrument for design of resilient, sustainable office buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Madeleine Flint, Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (vt.edu). MS Excel survey instrument used to assess the triple bottom line sustainability preferences of decision-makers as related to the early design of buildings and other infrastructure. Utility functions in the form of indifference curves are generated through assessment of a limited set of alternatives, and are usually obtained within 30 minutes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2GH3M. Keywords: Decision, Survey, Utility, Preference, Earthquake, Building. Published 2018-02-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
